warnings.why: An unemployment rate of 0.708% for advanced education is unrealistically low for Argentina's broader macroeconomic context and labor market conditions in recent years.
A rate of 0.982% implies virtually zero unemployment for tertiary-educated individuals, which is implausible given the structure of the Cambodian labor market and underemployment challenges.

While Qatar has very low overall unemployment, an advanced education unemployment rate of 0.3% is exceptionally low and likely reflects specific national-only or restricted labor force definitions rather than a universally comparable metric.
